title: ZTIE per-execution report contract (v1)
description: The bounded, DERIVED per-intake PER-EXECUTION REPORT PAYLOAD assembled by the Story 4.5 Hub-side report orchestrator (`hub_report`, RD-045) — the human-readable, audience-tiered counterpart to the real-time dashboard (4.3). It is served on demand by `intake_id` and rendered as a self-contained HTML document (print-to-PDF). It carries THREE AUDIENCE TIERS: EXECUTIVE (the risk score + a one-paragraph ADVISORY verdict, built by reusing the 4.1 read-model), SECURITY (correlated findings / behavioral chains + severity roll-ups + gaps, from the 3.2 correlation + 3.4 assessment), and DEVELOPER (prioritized remediations + candidate false positives + static<->dynamic correlation, from the 3.4 assessment). It is an ON-DEMAND DERIVED TRANSPORT SHAPE, NOT a durable stored record: 4.5 is a READ/transform behind an orchestrator Lambda, it adds NO durable tracking field and does NOT hang off the tracking-table stream. It is READ/transform only — it does NOT re-normalize / re-correlate / re-score / rebuild findings / re-derive the verdict (3.1-3.5, done) and makes NO model call (no Bedrock client, no Bedrock grant); it echoes + bounds + re-groups the already-derived Hub-side fields into three tiers. It is Hub-SIDE only (RD-009): it reasons ONLY over the derived Hub-side fields, NEVER the raw payload / findings text / raw trace (which never leave Forensic), and it never crosses the RD-013 gate. Raw-only detail (MITRE ATT&CK technique IDs, Sigma rules, exact file/line) is NOT carried on the Hub and is surfaced as an explicit `not_carried_on_hub` placeholder (a widen-the-crossing enrichment is a tracked follow-on story, NOT this one) — never fabricated. CRUCIALLY (RD-040), the 3.5 recommendation the Executive tier surfaces is ADVISORY and NEVER acted upon: the report surfaces the recommendation ALONGSIDE the human `decision`, whose only value 4.5 can report is `pending`; the advisory field is named `recommended_verdict` (NOT a bare `verdict`), and there is deliberately NO bare `verdict` / `safe` / `approved` / `forward` / `pass_fail` / `malicious` / `clean` field. Allow-list: additionalProperties false at every level; every field typed and enum/length/range-bounded; every array maxItems-capped (hard max 100). DERIVED-ONLY. OWN version pin (REPORT_CONTRACT_VERSION).

contract_version.description: Report payload schema version. Pinned SEPARATELY on the 4.5 Lambda (REPORT_CONTRACT_VERSION) so this shape versions independently of every stored-record contract's pin and of the 4.1/4.2 pins.

intake_id.description: The intake UUIDv4 this report is for.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the raw artifact body (integrity key bound to intake_id).

assembled_at.description: RFC3339/ISO-8601 UTC timestamp (Z-suffixed) the 4.5 Lambda ASSEMBLED this report. A payload assembly time, not a pipeline event time.

status.description: The tracking record's lifecycle status string (e.g. RECEIVED), echoed. Bounded, inert; NOT a verdict.

executive.description: EXECUTIVE tier: the risk score + a one-paragraph ADVISORY verdict, for a non-technical reader. Built by reusing the 4.1 read-model (RD-041): the combined risk score, the advisory recommended_verdict + pending human decision, and a one-paragraph summary. NEVER an effective decision (RD-040).

overall_stage.description: The furthest pipeline stage reached, honestly reported.

combined_score.description: The combined 3.3 risk score (0-100), echoed as the headline risk number. Present only when scored. EVIDENCE, never a verdict.

highest_gap_severity.description: The worst gap severity, echoed as context.

contradiction_present.description: True iff the lanes disagreed (a contradiction finding present).

recommendation.description: The 3.5 ADVISORY recommendation surfaced ALONGSIDE the human decision (RD-040): the recommended_verdict (when landed), the recommendation status, the one-paragraph summary, and decision=`pending` + advisory=`true`. NEVER acted upon; the advisory field is `recommended_verdict` (never a bare `verdict`).

recommended_verdict.description: The 3.5 ADVISORY recommended verdict (PASS / FAIL / INCONCLUSIVE), when landed. NEVER acted upon.

summary.description: The one-paragraph ADVISORY verdict narrative carried through from 3.5. Inert text; never a verdict field.

rubric_version.description: The shared 0-100 rubric version, carried through.

advisory.description: Always true: the recommended_verdict is ADVISORY and must never be acted upon automatically.

security.description: SECURITY tier: the correlated findings (behavioral chains), severity roll-ups, and the gaps, for a security reviewer. Built from the 3.2 correlation + the 3.4 assessment. `data_status` is `available` when the correlation/remediation records have landed, else `pending`. MITRE ATT&CK technique IDs and Sigma rules are NOT carried on the Hub (RD-013) — see `mitre_attack` / `sigma_rules` (`not_carried_on_hub`).

highest_finding_severity.description: The worst finding severity, echoed as context.

highest_correlation_severity.description: The worst correlation severity from 3.2, echoed as context.

findings.description: The bounded list of correlated findings (behavioral chains).

items.description: One correlated finding surfaced for the security reviewer — a behavioral chain / static<->dynamic correlation. Echoed from the 3.4 assessment `detailed_findings` (itself derived from the 3.2 correlation). EVIDENCE, never a verdict.

severity.description: The finding's severity (context, never a verdict).

detail.description: Bounded, inert finding detail (the behavioral chain narrative).

static_refs.description: Bounded references into the static-lane findings (inert ids).

behavioral_refs.description: Bounded references into the dynamic-lane behavioral indicators (inert ids).

items.description: One coverage/uncorroborated/contradiction gap surfaced for the security reviewer. Echoed from the 3.4 assessment `gaps`. EVIDENCE, never a verdict.

mitre_attack.description: An explicit, honest marker that a piece of report detail (e.g. MITRE ATT&CK technique IDs, Sigma rules, or exact file/line) is NOT carried on the Hub side — it is raw / Forensic detail deliberately kept behind the RD-013 gate. It is a PLACEHOLDER, never fabricated data; a widen-the-crossing enrichment is a tracked follow-on story. `status` is always `not_carried_on_hub` here.

status.description: Always `not_carried_on_hub` (an explicit placeholder, not an error).

note.description: Optional short, bounded, inert note explaining what is deferred.

sigma_rules.description: An explicit, honest marker that a piece of report detail (e.g. MITRE ATT&CK technique IDs, Sigma rules, or exact file/line) is NOT carried on the Hub side — it is raw / Forensic detail deliberately kept behind the RD-013 gate. It is a PLACEHOLDER, never fabricated data; a widen-the-crossing enrichment is a tracked follow-on story. `status` is always `not_carried_on_hub` here.

status.description: Always `not_carried_on_hub` (an explicit placeholder, not an error).

note.description: Optional short, bounded, inert note explaining what is deferred.

developer.description: DEVELOPER tier: the prioritized remediations (rank / priority / action / basis), the candidate false positives, and the static<->dynamic correlation, for the developer who must fix the artifact. Built from the 3.4 assessment. `data_status` is `available` when the remediation record has landed, else `pending`. Exact file/line is NOT carried on the Hub (RD-013) — see `source_location` (`not_carried_on_hub`).

prioritized_remediations.description: The bounded, rank-ordered remediation list (highest priority first).

items.description: One prioritized remediation for the developer — a ranked 'fix X' to-do, never 'reject the artifact'. Echoed from the 3.4 assessment `prioritized_remediations`. EVIDENCE + a to-do, never a verdict.

priority.description: low / medium / high / critical (banded from the rubric).

action.description: The bounded, inert 'fix X' action text (confirm / review / remediate).

basis.description: The bounded rationale for the ranking (risk score / severity cited).

source_kind.description: Which finding/gap kind motivated this remediation.

candidate_false_positives.description: The bounded list of candidate false positives to confirm/dismiss.

items.description: One candidate false positive for the developer to confirm/dismiss (a static finding not corroborated dynamically). Echoed from the 3.4 assessment `candidate_false_positives`. EVIDENCE, never a verdict.

source_location.description: An explicit, honest marker that a piece of report detail (e.g. MITRE ATT&CK technique IDs, Sigma rules, or exact file/line) is NOT carried on the Hub side — it is raw / Forensic detail deliberately kept behind the RD-013 gate. It is a PLACEHOLDER, never fabricated data; a widen-the-crossing enrichment is a tracked follow-on story. `status` is always `not_carried_on_hub` here.

status.description: Always `not_carried_on_hub` (an explicit placeholder, not an error).

note.description: Optional short, bounded, inert note explaining what is deferred.

report_note.description: Optional short, bounded, non-executable note framing this as a DERIVED read-only report whose recommendation is ADVISORY + human-gated. Descriptive, never a verdict.
